info.title: PlotRush account and commerce foundation
info.description: Generated from runtime Zod contracts. Scope: account, order, daily and staff editorial routes. Staff editorial routes require protected roles and a fresh MFA cookie. Payment simulation is local-only. Paystack test checkout, verification and signed webhook acknowledgement are implemented; live billing remains gated.

get.description: Export up to 31 inclusive UTC days of Paystack test sales and confirmed refunds by currency and play mode. Refunds use the date recorded in PlotRush. Amounts are in minor units before fees.
